draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Kothamangalam! People call this mountain town the Entrance of High Range, and it's packed with a dozen churches, half a dozen ancient temples and a few old mosques. Out here in Kuttampuzha, one forest panchayat covers 17.7% of all of Ernakulam district.
draft.hungryLine: I don't have a named restaurant for you here, so follow the locals to a Kerala meals spot in Kothamangalam town.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Go birdwatching at the Salim Ali Wild Life Sanctuary in Thattekkad, then take a boat out at Bhoothathan Kettu.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Catch a morning bus up to Mamalakandam, a very green mountain village on the Western Ghats.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Kuttampuzha was part of Idukki until 1998. Moving it to Ernakulam gave Ernakulam its border with Tamil Nadu.

legends.title: A dam built by a bhootham
legends.body: Legend says the old dam here was built out of rocks by a Bhootham, a spirit. That's where the name Bhoothathan Kettu comes from.

legends.title: Gateway to the hills
legends.body: Locals call Kothamangalam the Entrance of High Range, because the mountains start here. Its many churches, temples and mosques make it a big pilgrim centre too.

tips.title: Catch the early bus.
tips.body: Buses to Mamalakandam leave Kothamangalam at 8.25 am and 10.05 am.

tips.title: Bring binoculars.
tips.body: Exotic birds flock to the Thattekkad sanctuary, so you'll want to get a closer look.

story.title: An Idukki village
story.body: Kuttampuzha, with its thick forests, belonged to Idukki district. A big part of its people, 17.2%, are tribal communities.

story.title: Borders redrawn
story.body: District borders changed and Kuttampuzha moved to Ernakulam. That let Ernakulam touch Tamil Nadu and become part of the Anamalais.

story.title: A new panchayat
story.body: Edamalakkudy panchayat was formed, splitting off part of Kuttampuzha.

story.title: A huge village
story.body: The census found 24,799 people spread over 448 square kilometres, with literacy at 89.4%.

story.title: Your turn
story.body: Watch birds at Thattekkad, boat at Bhoothathan Kettu, then ride up to Mamalakandam. Tell me which bird you spotted first.
